name: Sojourner
summary: The first rover on Mars. It rolled off its lander in 1997 and studied rocks and soil in a valley called Ares Vallis.

name: Spirit
summary: One of twin robot geologists. Spirit landed in Gusev Crater, a possible old lake, and drove 7.7 kilometres before its mission ended in 2010.

sources.label: NASA Science: Spirit and Opportunity (challenge resource)

name: Opportunity
summary: Spirit's twin. Opportunity drove 45.16 kilometres on Mars and last talked to Earth on 10 June 2018, during a dust storm that covered the whole planet.

sources.label: NASA Science: Spirit and Opportunity (challenge resource)

name: Viking 1
summary: On 20 July 1976 Viking 1 made the first truly successful landing on Mars and sent the first photo from its surface. Its lander worked until November 1982.

name: Viking 2
summary: Viking 2 landed at Utopia Planitia on 3 September 1976, about 6,460 km from its twin. Its lander sent its last data in April 1980.

name: Phoenix
summary: Phoenix landed in 2008 on the far northern plains of Mars, the Martian arctic. As summer ended its power ran out, and its last signal came on 2 November 2008.

sources.label: NASA NSSDCA: Phoenix Mars Lander (challenge catalogue)

name: InSight
summary: InSight landed on Elysium Planitia in 2018 to study the inside of Mars. Its robotic arm placed a seismometer on the ground. Its mission ended on 15 December 2022.

name: Ingenuity
summary: The first aircraft to make a powered, controlled flight on another planet. Planned for at most five test flights, it flew 72 times. Its last flight was on 18 January 2024.

sources.label: NASA Science: Ingenuity Mars Helicopter (challenge resource)
